name: Cape Verde
dossier:
The Cape Verde national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Blue Sharks, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 67 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The ultimate giant-killers of the Atlantic, ready to unleash their speed and spirit in Group H.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Cape Verde will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group H and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group H. The connection between Ryan Mendes and Logan Costa is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Ryan Mendes - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Cape Verde are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: The Blue Sharks reached the quarter-finals of the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations, winning hearts globally.
